output.title: Help desk-driven MFA method registration followed by sign-in from new IP (Scattered Spider social engineering)
output.query:
let lookback = 7d;
let mfaChanges = AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where OperationName in~ ("User registered security info", "Admin registered security info", "User deleted security info", "Admin deleted security info", "Reset password (by admin)", "Reset user password", "Admin updated security info")
| extend Actor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), ActorIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
| extend TargetUpn = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
| where isnotempty(TargetUpn)
| where OperationName startswith "Admin" or OperationName has "by admin" or (isnotempty(Actor) and tolower(Actor) != tolower(TargetUpn))
| project ChangeTime = TimeGenerated, OperationName, Actor, ActorIp, TargetUpn, Result;
mfaChanges
| join kind=inner (
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | project SigninTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, SigninIp = IPAddress, Location, AppDisplayName, UserAgent, RiskLevelDuringSignIn
) on $left.TargetUpn == $right.UserPrincipalName
| where SigninTime between (ChangeTime .. ChangeTime + 4h)
| summarize FirstSignin = min(SigninTime), SigninIps = make_set(SigninIp, 10), Locations = make_set(Location, 10), Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 10) by ChangeTime, OperationName, Actor, ActorIp, TargetUpn, Result
| order by ChangeTime desc
expected_false_positives: Legitimate help desk password resets and MFA re-enrolment for users who lost or replaced a phone
New-hire onboarding where admins register MFA methods
Users signing in right after a legitimate reset from their normal location
output.tuning_notes: Restrict Actor to your help desk accounts or groups and alert when the subsequent sign-in IP or country differs from the user's baseline, or when the sign-in is not from a compliant device. Exclude onboarding automation accounts. Add a check that the sign-in IP is unseen in the prior 30 days for the user.
assumptions: Entra ID audit and sign-in logs are ingested into Sentinel
The operation names match the tenant's AuditLogs OperationName values
No table records the help desk phone call itself, so this is a proxy based on MFA and password changes by an admin
Actor and target field paths in InitiatedBy and TargetResources follow the standard schema

confidence.rationale: Admin-initiated MFA or password changes followed by sign-in is a reasonable proxy for help desk social engineering but matches much routine support activity.
